source: Problems-only A04 and the previously frozen four-wall directions study
reverse: Swap the source and absorber positions. Negate the launch vector. Actual native incidents reverse the order of the walls.
negativeControls: A 200 mm square, ray from (50,50) at 45 degrees, with true end gaps. It exits at a corner and must withhold claims of four hits or absorption.
An early absorber placed on the launch line before the first mirror must withhold the requested completed four-reflection path.
A native callback within 1 mm of a mirror endpoint must withhold the run even if an actual reflection is computed there.
A simulated terminal target hit without genuine absorption and a terminated budget cannot qualify.
scope: Numeric controls are synthetic and do not supply dimensions for the source problem. A single genuinely native ray, four finite axis-aligned separated plane mirrors, and one actual interior opaque line segment. No inferred route, no claim of a perfectly closed box, and no persistent ray history.
